neighbours.label: the word right before a hollow body organ is expected (womb, uterus, stomach), in pregnancy or digestion text: it predicts that organ
fire: During pregnancy the baby floats in fluid inside the mother's womb.
At twenty weeks the fetus can hear sounds from outside the womb.
The fertilized egg implants in the lining of the uterus.
Chewed food travels down the esophagus into the stomach.
The twins shared the same space in their mother's belly.
An ultrasound lets doctors see the baby inside the uterus.
Before birth, the child is fed through the cord in the womb.
Gastric juices in the stomach start to break down protein.
quiet: During the trip the baby slept in a basket in the car.
At twenty weeks the puppy could hear sounds from outside the house.
The new tile was laid along the lining of the pool.
Rain water travels down the pipe into the tank.
The twins shared the same room in their parents' house.
A camera lets guards see the yard behind the fence.
After lunch, the child was fed again in the kitchen.
Old leaves in the compost start to break down slowly.

notes: card: ' the', ' your' before uterus/womb/stomach; logit promotes uterus, womb, belly; probe: 'the mother's' 0.81 before womb, 'inside the' 0.65
